round_schedule: ChaCha alternating column round for even zero-based round index and diagonal round for odd index
cost_metric: number of exact quarter-round evaluations required by the word-level dependency cone; feed-forward word add/sub and comparison accounted separately
selection_rule: Choose the minimum total forward+backward QR cone. Break ties by smaller split, then smaller word index. This choice uses structure/cost only, never target outputs or oracle ranks.
verification: For random 16-word states, partial forward cone target word must equal full forward state at the split; partial inverse cone target word must equal full inverse state at the split.
claim_limit: Even a PASS here is only a constant-factor computation opportunity. It is not alpha<1. If the minimum cone remains Theta(rounds) and candidate enumeration remains 2^b, record that explicitly.
stage1_only_if_pass: Freeze a small boundary syndrome bit-width and fresh reduced-key targets, then measure survivor selectivity and TOTAL cost against direct full verification. No solver/ML rescue in Stage0.
